scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the Cascadia Care encrypted handoff export for the afternoon client review.
Emerging Need: The export job has started and staged files, then the same job halts with submitter controls disabled and administrator unlock required.
Decision Context: Schedule and platform records show when ordinary progress becomes an unrecoverable stoppage; the correct recovery owner is only in internal staff/contact records.
Consequence: If the paused job is not routed for clearance while recoverable, the partial export is discarded and the review cannot receive the intended packet.

parameter.title: Cascadia Care encrypted handoff build
parameter.description: Assemble and verify the exported portal localization packet before the client review.

parameter.subject: Export job CCN-4627-E started
parameter.body: The encrypted handoff export for Cascadia Care project LM-4627 has started. Current state: 64 of 210 localized portal files staged; checksum preflight running under submitter session Tessa Elian.

parameter.content: Cascadia Care moved the packet review to 2:30 today. If the encrypted export is ready by 1:45, I can still preview the delivery manifest before joining them.

parameter.subject: Export job CCN-4627-E halted in recoverable queue
parameter.body: The active encrypted handoff export CCN-4627-E has stopped at file 118 after an attachment-key mismatch. Submit, retry, and cancel controls are disabled for the submitter session. Recovery state: Paused-Recoverable until 11:00; release requires Workspace Export Administrator queue unlock.

parameter.subject: Export job CCN-4627-E discarded after recovery timeout
parameter.body: The paused encrypted handoff export CCN-4627-E exceeded its recovery window. The partial package has been discarded and the next clean export slot for Cascadia Care is after 15:30 today.
